meta.title: WoW Forever collectible quests and secrets
meta.method_note: Fan-site pages could not be fetched directly (network allowlist); facts come from web-search summaries of the cited pages, written in our own words. Where a coordinate came only from an MIT-licensed addon (Whatnot) it is marked as such. No GPL addon data was used. Re-checked live on 2026-11-26 against game-data databases (see verified).
meta.step_schema: action in accept|turnin|click|use|emote|kill|collect|goto|talk|note (note = no known place, no coordinates); ids are null when no source gave them. accept/turnin carry quest_id, talk/kill carry npc_id, click/collect carry object_id where the game data has one.
meta.confidence_rule: high = 2+ sources agree on locations/steps; medium = one good source or partly unverified coordinates; low = sources conflict or availability unconfirmed.
not_included: Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle (Legacy System reward at 15 points, not a quest)
Pouch of Violet Dust (time-limited Twitch drop)
Minfernal, Shaking Egg, Tallstrider Hatchling, Condor Hatchling (plain rare-mob drops: Immolatus in Felwood, Lord Condar in Loch Modan, Strider Clutchmother in Darkshore)
Galestrider mounts (vendor and reputation sources per Wowhead mount guide)

verified.checked_live: Every quest id, giver/ender, NPC id and NPC/object position was opened in the Out of Games WoW Forever database (game data 1.60.1) and/or Warcraft DB Forever (quest, NPC, object and item pages incl. tooltips); Dawn Waker walkthroughs on warcraft-secrets.com, guided.news, WoW Handbook, Endgame Tools and Expcarry; Alcaz Prison guides on lfcarry and guided.news; Prairie Chicken pages on forevercompanions, wowforever.be, wow4evernews and ForeverChanges.
verified.not_reachable: Wowhead Forever (HTTP 403 CloudFront block), warcraft.wiki.gg (bot challenge), Icy Veins, Zockify and Conquest Capped could not be opened; claims only from them are marked as such.
verified.changed: reward_item_id filled for all 14 collectibles (12 were empty or single-source); quest ids filled for The Man in the Iron Chains (96335), More Valuable Than Gold (96337), the Alliance/neutral State Secrets (96377/96379), My Little Friends (93176), the 11-part Raene's Cleansing chain, The Ancient Hilt/Eluvi'ana/Baron Marinous/Baron Aquanis (93161/97029/98028/6922); npc/object ids on all talk/kill/click steps the data knows; coordinates added to every goto/click/emote step (Alcaz entrance from two guides). Night Watchman's Torch retyped as item (no Toy line), Shimmerwine set to Alliance, Dawn Waker extended past Prince Tortheldrin.
verified.uncertain: Dawn Waker final step/reward (unsolved); Arcanum of Binding steps single-source; Night Watch Guard body rotates; Pack Kodo price/reputation gate; Weevil catch spots; Sewer Beast drop rate; whether Horde can loot an Alliance-laid Chicken Egg.

This Must Be The Place: Cozy Sleeping Bag + Student Fodder

collectibles.level_note: The Man in the Iron Chains and More Valuable Than Gold: level 53, require 48. State Secrets requires 48. Fractured Insignia requires level 40 to use.

collectibles.name: Dawn Waker (Eluvi'ana)
collectibles.type_note: Secret chain. Confirmed reward: Eluvi'ana (item 276188), an uncommon unique one-hand sword (ilvl 15, 'The Night Dancer'). The chain continues toward its twin blade Eluvi'tor; the documented trail now reaches an enchanted Ancient Hilt and a Scrawled Note from Prince Tortheldrin, and the final step/reward is still unsolved (26 Nov 2026).
collectibles.faction_note: Both factions; the water-globe step differs (Alliance: Baron Marinous quest 98028 is Alliance-only; Horde: Baron Aquanis quest 6922 is Horde-only).
collectibles.level_note: Part 1 (sword) is low level (Ealaane is level 10); later steps need 50+ and a 5-player group, plus Dire Maul.

steps.note: Thendal Village, top floor of the treehouse (object 676051). Skyborne characters get it from the quest Coming of Age (92460: Ailee Farheart 251362 at 42.8, 23.4 to Rorian the Dayseeker 251361 at 42.1, 23.5) instead. Wear it: it reveals elven spirits and hidden vaults.
See the Night Watchman's Torch entry (quest 98372; the guard's body rotates).
Back of the Ruins of Ban'aethal: light the torch to reveal the Ancient Hilt. World boss Altairus is close; wait until he rests or pull him away and let him reset, no need to kill him.
Click the revealed Ancient Hilt (object 676059); it starts the quest.
Ealaane Nimbuswalker near Valanaar; she keeps nothing, you get the Ancient Hilt item (282315) - keep it.
Ealaane asks for the Ancient Skyborne Blade.
From a small blue Ancient Sword object (618822) on the mountainside; it can spawn at several places (alt).
Ealaane returns Eluvi'ana. You can stop here if you only want the sword.
Alliance route: Stormscale naga (Myrmidon 2181, Sorceress, Warrior, Beastmistress) near the Ruins of Mathystra; combine them into the Mathystral Amulet (item 279277).
Alliance: use the amulet at the Fathom Stone to fight him (elite, level 21); loot the Clouded Water Globe, which starts the quest Baron Marinous.
Started by the Clouded Water Globe (Alliance-only, requires 17).

steps.target: Onu (hand in Baron Marinous, then talk again)
steps.note: Onu at the Grove of the Ancients; then talk to him again to receive the Befouled Water Globe (item 282337). The extra conversation is required. (Kept as a talk step so the Eluvi'ana quest 97029 stays this entry's completion flag; quest 98028 is the hand-in.)
Horde route: inside Blackfathom Deeps; loot the Strange Water Globe (item 16782), which starts the quest Baron Aquanis.
Started by the Strange Water Globe (Horde-only, requires 21).

steps.target: Je'neu Sancrea (hand in Baron Aquanis, then talk again)
steps.note: Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost; then talk again for the Befouled Water Globe (282337). (Kept as a talk step so the Eluvi'ana quest 97029 stays this entry's completion flag; quest 6922 is the hand-in.)
Zoram Strand, with the ring equipped and the globe in bags; it sends you after Athrikus Narassin's tome.
Top of the Tower of Althalaxx; loot the Azsharan Key (item 282406).
Right behind him: open it with the key for Narassin's Tome (item 282404), then return to the Highborne Spirit (15.7, 19.3 Ashenvale).
Evenshade's spot in Shen'dralas (uiMapID 2652). Have Narassin's Tome in your bags; he names three cleansing materials (completion flag: quest 98642).

steps.target: Shen'dralar Vault switches + vault (Star of Elune)
steps.note: Ruins of Isildien, ring equipped, level 50+ advised. Five players: four flip the hidden Ancient Switches within ~10 s of each other at 58.5,71.0 (top floor) / 57.3,71.8 / 59.7,72.0 / 61.0,73.7 while the fifth loots the Star of Elune (item 282548).
Underwater Abyssal Chest, visible only after the long Azsharite questline (ends with 3602 'Azsharite', Loramus Thalipedes). Gives item 282547.

steps.target: Anguished / Suffering Highborne (20 Tears of Anguish)
steps.note: Lake Kel'Theril ghosts, level 54-56 (npc 7524 / 7523); drops not guaranteed. Item 282431.
At the Shrine of Coalescence (object 677445) with the Star, the Mote and the tears: creates the Cleansed Water Globe (item 282699).
Show him the Cleansed Water Globe; he points you to Prince Tortheldrin.
Dire Maul West (Capital Gardens). Asked about Eluvi'ana and Eluvi'tor he lashes out and says nothing more until you carry a Royal Seal of Eldre'Thalas (from your class's Dire Maul quest).

Dire Maul library. Bring the Libram of Binding (item 282712, drops in Dire Maul), 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards and 1 Arcane Crystal for the Arcanum of Binding (item 282707) (warcraft-secrets.com; single source).
Enchant the Ancient Hilt (282315), then talk to Prince Tortheldrin again: he hands you a Scrawled Note (item 283387) with a riddle signed 'L' (single source).

End of the documented trail (26 Nov 2026). The riddle hints at 'flames born of air'; the community's lead is to bring the enchanted hilt to Altairus (Caller of the North Wind, npc 251461, Ruins of Ban'aethal on Zephras Isle) so he breathes on it. Unconfirmed; the final reward (Eluvi'tor?) is unknown.

collectibles.notes: Steps up to Prince Tortheldrin agree across warcraft-secrets.com, guided.news, WoW Handbook, Endgame Tools and Expcarry, and every NPC/object/item id and position here was checked against the game data (Out of Games, Warcraft DB). The Arcanum of Binding / Scrawled Note steps come from warcraft-secrets.com only. Mordent's zone is Shen'dralas (uiMapID 2652). Final step and reward still unsolved.

collectibles.name: Replica Dartol's Rod of Transformation
collectibles.effect: Turns you into a furbolg for 3 min (1 min cooldown); game-data tooltip marks it as a Toy. Reward of the last Raene's Cleansing (1046); the quest rod is taken back at the final turn-in.

steps.note: Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. Eleven-part chain, every part named Raene's Cleansing; it starts with 991.
Teronis' Corpse at Lake Falathim.
From Teronis' Corpse: find the Glowing Gem and bring it with Teronis' Journal to Raene.
Search around the corpse for the Glowing Gem (item 5463; random, may take several tries).
Raene Wolfrunner.
Shael'dryn at the moonwell east of Iris Lake; give her the gem.
Wooden Key and the first piece of Dartol's Rod.
Treants drop the Wooden Key; the chest (object 19022) is near the Felwood border.
Last piece of the rod.
Appears after killing the Rotting Slimes; the chest (object 19021) has several spawn points in south-east Ashenvale (alt).
Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant the rod.
Hidden Shrine (object 19024): gives Dartol's Rod of Transformation (item 5462).
From the shrine.
Find an uncorrupted furbolg and speak to him through the rod.
Krolg at Mystral Lake: use the rod first, then talk.
Tough fight; loot his skull (item 5388). Guards are npc 3932.
Bring the skull and the rod to Raene.
Reward: the Replica Dartol's Rod toy plus a choice of Glacial Stone, Gutterblade or Ring of Pure Silver.

collectibles.notes: Alliance-only chain (every part is Alliance in the game data), requires level 18, quest levels 19-31. Order, NPC ids and positions were re-checked on the Forever 1.60.1 data (Out of Games); the old note that the chain starts with 1028 was wrong (it starts with 991).
